title: FHE Ads
tagline: Crypto doesn't have to be a tradeoff: Earn money while personalizing your web and staying 100% private
description:
## Pitch

Your browser knows you really well - your interests, habits, location, etc.
This data can 100% personalize your web experience - youtube recommends, twitter feed, news feeds, ads, etc.
But Google is gate-keeping this data to rent-extract ads.

Our hack works similar to Google Ads, while being 100% private and giving all ad revenue to the user. 

## Our stack

- Chrome extension to get browser history (100% local)
- Ollama to analyze history (100% local) or use your GPT/Claude/Perplexity API key
- Fhenix to let advertisers buy ads based on your interests (100% private using FHE) 
 
## Roadmap

In the future, our platform could be used to personalize not just ads, but any web2 data - like Youtube video recommends, Netflix movies, Tweets, Farcasts, shopping items on Amazon, AI girlfriends, ...
how_its_made:
Using a chrome extension to get browser history locally
Using local Ollama LLM API, GPT, Claude, Perplexity APIs to prompt for user interests and receive content recommendations.
And using Fhenix for FHE, to privately match advertisers with user interests.
Written in javascript.
